zh-CN.title: 深色模式更舒适
items: 优化聊天操作、记录搜索、互动额度与确认弹窗的深色对比度
通知设置和头像框预览在深色模式下更柔和、更易读

en.title: A more comfortable dark mode
items: Improved dark-mode contrast across message actions, chat search, activity allowances, and confirmations
Notification settings and avatar-frame previews are now softer and easier to read in dark mode
